name: Zentree Ultima WP Ply
description: Boiling Water Proof (BWP) grade, high-density, calibrated plywood made from 100% Gurjan and Nilgiri (Eucalyptus). Borer and termite-proof, featuring equal thickness on all four sides, and includes a lifetime warranty.
features: Calibrated for equal thickness on all four sides

name: Zentree Gold WP Ply
description: Premium waterproof plywood featuring a signature red core, engineered to be borer and termite-proof. Composed of a durable blend of Neem, Gurjan, and Nilgiri, it is highly recommended for both kitchen and wardrobe cabinets.
features: Signature Red Core for quality assurance
Optimized for high-moisture kitchen and wardrobe areas
Constructed from durable Neem, Gurjan & Nilgiri species

name: Zentree Gurjan Com Ply
description: Semi-calibrated commercial plywood constructed using 100% premium Neem and Gurjan wood. Designed to offer full thickness strength, making it the perfect choice for wardrobes and bedroom cabinets.
features: Full thickness profile for superior load-bearing

name: Zentree Project Com Ply
description: This plywood is a budget option constructed using a mix of Neem and other species, featuring full thickness. It is intended for wardrobe applications and is available in thicknesses from 6mm to 18mm. It comes in 8x4 and 7x4 sheet sizes.

specs.Wood Species: Mix of Neem and other species

features: Constructed using a mix of Neem & other species
Full thickness profile for budget cabinets
